svg.desc: индикатор положения регулятора для Dull Screen

rt:param.name: BG_StaticColor
rt:param.comment: Имя цвета подложки, если объект не должен быть прозрачным

rt:param.name: Color_Readings
rt:param.comment: Индикация производится окрашенными цифрами на подложке из конфигурации (BG_StaticColor игнорируется)

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub StatusColor () Dim Tmp_Color As UInt If (pv == nothing) Then Value_text.text = "Ош." Value_text.font_size = 20 Tmp_Color = Color_ANA_ER_LINK ElseIf (pv.Value < -25) || (pv.Value > 125) Then Value_text.text = "***" Tmp_Color = Color_Inval Else Value_text.text = RoundAscii(pv.Value, 0, True) Tmp_Color = PRJSPEC.ANA_Color_pv (pv) End If If Color_Readings Then Backgr.visibility = "hidden" Value_text.fill = Tmp_Color Else Backgr.fill = Tmp_Color If ShowGoodColor Then If Tmp_Color == Color_ANA_GOOD Then Backgr.fill_opacity = 0.5 Else Backgr.fill_opacity = 1 End If Else If Tmp_Color == Color_ANA_GOOD Then Backgr.visibility = "hidden" Else Backgr.visibility = "visible" End If End If End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: If KKS != "NULL" Then If SIGNAL == "NULL" Then If (!requests_allown) Then pv = ANA(KKS + "_" + Signal_RegValve_Pos) Else pv = ANA(KKS + "_AA1") If pv == Nothing Then pv = ANA(KKS + "_" + Signal_RegValve_Pos) End If End If Else pv = ANA(KKS + Delimiter + SIGNAL) End If ElseIf IsViewMode Then Value_text.text = "Ош." Value_text.font_size = 20 Backgr.fill = Color_ANA_ER_LINK Exit Sub End If If Color_Readings Then Static_BG.fill = Color_ANA_BG EU.fill = Color_ANA_EU InGrObj_InGrCorner.fill_opacity = 0 InGrObj_InGrFrame.x = -2.5 InGrObj_InGrFrame.y = -2.5 InGrObj_InGrFrame.width = Backgr.width + 5 InGrObj_InGrFrame.height = Backgr.height + 5 // InGrObj_InGrFrame.stroke_width = 1 Else Static_BG.fill = BG_StaticColor Value_text.fill = Color_DIGITS_G6 End If

rect.rt:event:
If pv == nothing Then If SIGNAL == "NULL" Then NoLink(KKS) Else ShowWarning ("Ошибка привязки.
KKS = "" + KKS + ""
Delimiter = "" + Delimiter + ""
SIGNAL = "" + SIGNAL + """, 0) End If Else LoadPopUpMenu(pv.PVId + "|ANAi|ws_ANA_FN " + pv.PVId + "|-1") End If

If pv == nothing Then If SIGNAL == "NULL" Then NoLink(KKS) Else ShowWarning ("Ошибка привязки.
KKS = "" + KKS + ""
Delimiter = "" + Delimiter + ""
SIGNAL = "" + SIGNAL + """, 0) End If Else Call_Win ("ws_ANA_FN", pv.PVId + "|-1") End If
